release_schema_manifest.generated_from: accepted migration lineage plus LLD-approved schema contracts
release_schema_manifest.committed: yes; release/runtime does not regenerate expected truth from the database it is verifying
release_schema_manifest.rule: unknown, missing or structurally different authoritative object blocks readiness unless explicitly classified as SQLite-owned/internal

exact_schema_check: read sqlite_schema using parameterized read queries
exclude documented sqlite_* internal objects only
compare object name/type/table and canonical structural contract against release manifest
verify required columns via PRAGMA table_xinfo including name/type/notnull/default/pk/hidden
verify STRICT/WITHOUT ROWID flags where specified
verify foreign keys via PRAGMA foreign_key_list including parent/child columns and ON UPDATE/DELETE actions
verify indexes via PRAGMA index_list/index_xinfo including uniqueness and ordered leading columns
verify required append-only triggers exist with accepted trigger identity/behavior
fail closed on extra authoritative-looking objects rather than silently ignoring them

fk_index_coverage.algorithm: for each foreign key child-column sequence, find a usable index whose ordered key-column leading prefix exactly covers the child sequence; a wider composite index is valid only when FK columns are the leading prefix in order; non-partial indexes qualify directly, and partial indexes qualify only under the closed nullable_partial_rule below

nullable_partial_rule.eligibility: The exact index and predicate must be allocated by the owning LLD and present in the release schema manifest. At least one child FK column is nullable. Key columns must meet the same leading-prefix and usable comparison/collation rules as a full index.
nullable_partial_rule.predicate: A nonempty conjunction of <child FK column> IS NOT NULL terms, with every referenced column belonging to this exact FK. No OR, lifecycle/status filter, other-column condition, function, expression or parameter qualifies automatically.
nullable_partial_rule.proof: SQLite enforces a composite child FK only when all its child columns are non-null. Every enforcement-relevant child row therefore satisfies each permitted predicate term. No operational history row relevant to FK enforcement is excluded.
nullable_partial_rule.verification: Read the actual predicate and ordered key columns; do not infer coverage from index name or current data. Compare them with the accepted structural contract. Predicate parsing is limited to this closed shape, not a generic SQL implication engine.
negative_cases: FK-column non-null term AND an additional restrictive term
expression key replacing a child column
nullable_partial_rule.exception_policy: Other partial predicates need the existing measured and explicitly accepted exception path. A qualifying nullable partial index needs no separate exception entry or duplicate full index.

fk_index_coverage.default: no exception; missing effective index blocks readiness and tests

integrity_checks: PRAGMA quick_check returns exactly ok during ordinary startup
PRAGMA integrity_check is required after restore and in explicit deep-maintenance verification
instance_metadata has exactly one valid row
schema_migrations exactly matches accepted manifest prefix/current state
audit append-only triggers reject update/delete probes inside rolled-back verification transaction
publication_rule: host state cannot become READY until all required current-version checks pass
